findings.title: The plan price does not stand out in each plan card

location.description: The three plan cards under the Plan heading, the monthly price line at the bottom of each card

findings.viewer_experience: The price is the fact a person compares across the three plans, but it sits in the same size, weight and grey as the description above it, so the eye has to read every line to find it.

current.value: The monthly price has the same size, weight and tone as the one-line description above it.

findings.target: The monthly price is the first thing the eye lands on in each plan card, ahead of the description.
findings.fix_direction: Give the price a clear step up from the description in the three plan cards, so it leads the card.
findings.source: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Visual Design

closed_when.check: Look at the three plan cards: the monthly price is clearly the most prominent text in each card.
